value.rationale: Hapax richness is a natural global novelty statistic while number of runs measures local fragmentation. A constructive unbounded number of dependence sign reversals disproves uniform one-switch expectations and reveals a rare-scale mechanism. Binary rigidity and explicit ternary minimal witness make the boundary nontrivial rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
